title: Arup Hong Kong (deepfake CFO video call)
summary: A staff member in engineering firm Arup's Hong Kong office received a message said to be from the company's UK-based chief financial officer about a confidential transaction, then joined a video conference with the false CFO and other AI-generated employees. The employee made transfers totalling about US$25 million to five Hong Kong bank accounts before discovering the fraud. Arup notified Hong Kong police in January 2024 and confirmed to the Financial Times that false voices and images were used. No one has been publicly charged.

journey.note: An employee joined a video call where the CFO and colleagues were deepfakes, then authorised the transfers.
